levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن شبوية المروزي

notes: three taḥwīl branches with no «قالا» or «جميعا» to mark a shared tail: the first branch ends at Zuhri and the second at Isma'il, while the text writes Zuhri, Humayd and the mother only after the last branch; whether those branches run on into that tail is not settled; «أن النبي» ends the chain; the «وقال أحمد بن محمد ومسدد» wording variant is not a route
